$why: Between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-20 five components each had to be taught 'this is a resume'
separately, one live failure at a time: the launcher tore the codeline down, the lifecycle
passed --reset, pre-run-reset archived the run's ledgers, pre-flight refused the run's own
spec blocks and healing ledger, and the remediation reset 14 completed stories ($20). Each
read EPAM_RESUME_RUN on its own and decided on its own what that meant. This file is the
one statement of what a resume keeps; lib/resume-semantics.sh (and its Python twin) answers
resume_preserves <aspect> from it; every consumer asks. An aspect not listed here is refused
loudly by the reader — never guessed.

preserves.prd-state: The PRD on disk is the run's own working copy — never restored from the authored canonical (tier3-run 2026-09-16, pre-flight 2026-09-15).
preserves.codeline: The output directory holds the run's committed work; it is not torn down or reinitialised (tier3-run 2026-09-16).
preserves.ledgers: phase-gates, phase-cost, healing-events, run-guidance, code-reviews and the other JSONL ledgers under LOG_DIR, and the per-story writer-rung (story-rung/) and ladder-state (story-retry-state/) records, are this run's record — not archived or cleared (pre-run-reset 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-21, pre-flight 2026-09-19).
preserves.roster: The roster and agent profiles this run minted and reviewed are reused byte-for-byte; the specialiser is not called again (pre-run-reset 2026-09-19).
preserves.prompts: The prompt set built for this run's codeline is reused, not rebuilt (2026-09-19).
preserves.fetched-documents: Referenced documents and the estate survey fetched for this run are kept (pre-run-reset 2026-09-18).
preserves.phase-gates: A phase whose gate already decided GO is recognised as completed and not run again (greenfield-lifecycle 2026-09-16).
preserves.completed-stories: A story marked completed keeps its status and record; only failed, blocked or in-progress stories are re-queued; the orchestrator runs without --reset (greenfield-lifecycle 2026-09-16, prd-remediate 2026-09-20).
preserves.spec-blocks: Specification blocks on pending stories are this run's own spec pass, not prior-run contamination (prd-remediate and pre-flight 2026-09-15).
preserves.checkpoint: The run's checkpoint (roster, prompts, PRD, briefs) is restored and owned by this run; a later launch may displace, never overwrite (run-checkpoint 2026-09-19).
